description: Memory management routines for qhull, including custom allocators, free lists, and statistics functions.

methods.name: qh_intcompare
methods.description: Compare two integers used by qsort and bsearch.

methods.name: qh_memalloc
methods.description: Allocate memory of specified size, using freelists for small sizes or malloc for large sizes.

methods.name: qh_memcheck
methods.description: Check consistency of memory freelists and total free memory.

methods.name: qh_memfree
methods.description: Free memory object, returning it to freelist or freeing via malloc.

methods.name: qh_memfreeshort
methods.description: Free all short and qhull memory allocations.

methods.name: qh_meminit
methods.description: Initialize memory management system, testing pointer sizes.

methods.name: qh_meminitbuffers
methods.description: Set up memory buffers and freelist sizes.

methods.name: qh_memsetup
methods.description: Set up memory after running memsize.

methods.name: qh_memsize
methods.description: Define a free list for a specific size.

methods.name: qh_memtotal
methods.description: Return total and current memory allocations for long and short memory.
